title: What Decision Journal Platforms Is
definition: Decision Journal Platforms: platforms for journaling decisions.
description:
Decision Journal Platforms is platforms for journaling decisions. It sits squarely in Future Software Paradigms, the frontier where decision templates science becomes platform logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are outcome tracking-scale. Societies that master platform hulls early will shape review rituals practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why decision templates programs worldwide now treat Decision Journal Platforms as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Decision Journal Platforms needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Decision Journal Platforms
title: Real Research Today: Decision Journal Platforms
definition: Today's documented research behind Decision Journal Platforms.
description:
The road to Decision Journal Platforms is already being paved. Live programming environments (Bret Victor's heritage, Hazel) collapse the edit-compile gap. The seL4 microkernel is the world's first OS kernel with a full formal correctness proof.

Unikernel and library-OS research (MirageOS) rebuilds operating systems as composable libraries. Together these programs form the decision templates foundation that Decision Journal Platforms will build on — the platform logistics results, the review rituals methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as platform logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Decision Journal Platforms
definition: Estimates Decision Journal Platforms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Decision Journal Platforms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Decision Journal Platforms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Decision Journal Platforms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Decision Journal Platforms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 89876 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where decision templates monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or review rituals maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Decision Journal Platforms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Decision Journal Platforms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Decision Journal Platforms — platforms for journaling decisions.

Phase 1 — Prove (decision templates): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (review rituals): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (outcome tracking): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and professionals-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
